R142.note: Unidentified assailants beat policeman to death in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, 18 Nov.

R144.note: 53-year-old woman shot and seriously injured at house in Tur'an, Saturday evening; shooter unknown.

R145.note: Colombian president says forces air-struck ELN in Cauca, nine killed.

R148.note: Romania F-16s shot down two drones over Black Sea on Oct 17; not a fighter jet, not Russia.

R150.note: Brothers-in-law stabbed man, attempted homicide, in Rorainopolis not Boa Vista, on the 17th; survived.

R152.note: Page has only headline: Fidan says Mecca Agreement is not an attack agreement; no violence reported.

R157.note: Unidentified men abducted Tanzanian activist in Machakos, Kenya; not reported as Tanzanian state acting on Kenya.

R159.note: Assailants killed a history-sheeter in Jaipur with sticks and axe; no military force.

R160.note: Boyfriend Pedro Henrique suspected of shooting Clear Medeiros in face in Parnagua on Oct 16; she survived.
